metadata.description: Five standalone product-design agents — install only the ones you need.

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Turns a raw idea into a validated PRD — discovery, direction validation, user stories, and spec in one pass

plugins.name: ux-designer
plugins.description: Reviews a design's usability, accessibility, copy, consistency, and resilience against the PRD

plugins.name: ui-designer
plugins.description: Generates designs, binds them to a design system, polishes the visuals, and audits for drift

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: Produces a test plan with manual cases, regression scope, and a bug-report template from a PRD

plugins.name: ui-reference-researcher
plugins.description: Maps each PRD section to its user story and finds matching real-world UI references on Mobbin, delivered as an annotated comparison doc with embedded screenshots
